title: Explicit supported profile
requirement: WHEN a program is admitted, tooling SHALL report its exact supported grammar and versioned execution profile.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: First-order fragment
scenarios.when: A program uses named calls, UInt128, Bool, constructor and match expressions.
scenarios.then: Its report names those constructs, numeric domains, schedule and code/data/frame/environment/serialization/helper-work bounds; closed-body and unique-function admission remain explicit implementation work, while higher-order closures/letrec remain extensions. AdmissionRejected and tooling Unsupported are distinguished from runtime outcomes.

expected.failure classes: admission failure reported outside the runtime outcome schema; runtime Rejected is a separate application outcome

unasserted: closed-body and unique-function admission (stated as remaining implementation work in the spec)
